sous_titre: Variation trimestrielle des dépôts nationaux, en pourcentage, du troisième trimestre 2025 au deuxième trimestre 2026

series.nom: Dépôts nationaux des banques américaines assurées

T3 2025.texte: Domestic deposits increased $92.2 billion (0.5 percent) from second quarter 2025, rising for a fifth consecutive quarter.

T4 2025.texte: Domestic deposits grew 1.8 percent, the sixth consecutive quarterly increase.

T1 2026.texte: Domestic deposits grew 2.1 percent, the seventh consecutive quarterly increase.

T2 2026.texte: Domestic deposits grew 0.8 percent, the eighth consecutive quarterly increase.
